info.title: NYALES M1 catalog, invoice and map implemented slice
info.description: Local implementation 18 October 2026; baseline full API remains separate. Firebase/provider/MFA/ERP production and map quota gates remain open. currency IDR exponent0; all money fields full rupiah integers max1e12 per record; no float currency conversion. JSON source versions monotonic positive integer strings. CSV UTF8 max512KiB/200data rows. No stock or credit eligibility fabricated.

post.description: Body {reason:string}; no hard delete; products become inactive and groups archived.
Body {reason:string}; no hard delete; products become inactive and groups archived.
Price in full IDR/base-unit. Date end exclusive; closes prior interval; no backdate/same-date/future-schedule overwrite.
Private source SHA256 is verified. Validation hash + organization finance/reference epoch guard atomic commit. If-Match job ETag required for commit, optional for dry-run.

period_start/end inclusive ISO dates; channel,area_id,rep_id,status,source_system,customer_id narrow authorized scope. Latest200rows + has_more, totals include all matches. format=csv admin-only export max5000matches; exports metadata/filter/timezone/cutoff. Draft/cancelled/needs_review excluded from eligible totals. One current revision per org/source/external-ID.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Opt in to SQL paging. UI defaults to 50 with 50/100 choice; omitted retains legacy first 200.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Requires limit. Filters apply before pagination; live offsets may shift under writes.

x-pagination.totals: All filtered results, independent of page. CSV exports all filtered results within existing export cap.

get.summary: Current invoice detail, lines and credit snapshot
get.description: ETag is revision_no. Only current revision ID is a detail/action root; get history through revisions. Full-unit IDR exponent0; source net and eligible net separate.
200latest + has_more; historical row visibility uses its own rep/area/channel scope.

post.description: Current invoice ETag required. Source version increases. Revalidates dated mapping. Restates invoice origin period; finalized reference creates finance_adjustment pending_review and never rewrites finalized statement. Later finalization module must populate finance_period_lock and consume adjustment.

get.summary: Last received positions with age, source and accuracy
get.description: area_id,rep_id,channel only narrow scope. Invalid/future timestamps return age_seconds=null and explicit clock_status. No tracking ingestion/routing.

get.summary: Scoped customer pins, all-customer table and last positions
get.description: area_id,rep_id,channel,customer_status filters. Missing coordinates remain in all_customers and counts; inactive outlets not pinned. Basemap config from environment; fallback OSM is local pilot only.

ImportRequest.description: Either uploaded CSV attachment+mapping or JSON invoice/credit arrays. Total invoice+line+credit records max200. Strict atomic batch; commit repeats identical payload with validation_batch_id and job If-Match. Per-row validation errors produce needs_review dry-run, not a partial commit.
